tagline: Text file uploads: You can now upload plaintext (.txt) files to a Genie One conversation, in addition to the other supported file types.
what_it_does: Text file uploads: You can now upload plaintext (.txt) files to a Genie One conversation, in addition to the other supported file types. Streaming responses: Genie One now streams responses in real time as they're generated, so answers appear progressively instead of loading all at the same time. Download a chat: You can now download a Genie One chat.
why_it_matters: Low: This level lowers the cost for simpler tasks.
